name: Romeo & Juliet
source:
The war between vampires and humans has safely concluded in Verona. Though tension were stiff and awkward, the two races began to interact and gradually accepted each other.

The main character is delighted at the fact that her efforts have helped brought Verona to a change. However, on the other hand, she, as a Capulet, holds complicated emotions, as she has a personal grudge against vampires...

Meanwhile, an immense crisis draws near the still-developing Verona. Who's hand will the main character take this time, and will she be able to overcome the ordeal?

As the sequel to "Romeo VS Juliet", the story will start from right before the protagonist and the characters of interest become lovers. Characters such as Tybalt and Shakespeare that were not made into main routes in the previous game can now become your lover.

This romantic fantasy adventure game is based off of "Romeo and Juliet".
translation:
吸血鬼与人类之间的战争在维罗纳安全结束。尽管紧张气氛僵硬而尴尬，但这两个种族开始互动并逐渐相互接受。

主角很高兴她的努力帮助维罗纳发生了变化。但另一方面，作为凯普莱特家族的她却有着复杂的情绪，因为她与吸血鬼有着私人恩怨……

与此同时，仍在发展中的维罗纳正面临一场巨大的危机。这次主角会牵着谁的手，她能否克服磨难呢？

作为《罗密欧VS朱丽叶》的续集，故事将从主角与感兴趣的人物成为恋人之前开始。提伯尔特、莎士比亚等前作中未进入主线的角色现在可以成为你的恋人。

这是一款浪漫奇幻冒险游戏，改编自《罗密欧与朱丽叶》。
